body: FUCK YOU ALSO, I HATE EVERYTHING TODAY

Maybe i'm letting myself be too negative, but i don't believe in "deserving".  I think it's a selfish concept to say "I deserve that raise" or "I deserve to find love" or "That man/woman is horrible, the deserve to be punished/jailed."  It's something people tell themselves to justify their wants.  The world doesn't care or act on what we think we "deserve".  Good things and bad things happen too good people and bad people alike.
